correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the tensor contraction to an intrinsic two-corner inequality on the von Neumann predual, obtains trace-free finite-set localization from the arbitrary-atomless small-corner lemma, and constructs an explicit contraction Phi=(C tensor I)+H(.)z_prime. Corner orientations, slice normalization, projective-norm estimates, and algebraic-tensor approximation errors were checked separately.

originality.rationale: The September 2026 tensor theorem is explicitly semifinite, while the August 2026 arbitrary-predual theorem stops at M_* itself. Exact and synonymous literature searches found no arbitrary diffuse-von-Neumann theorem for M_* projective-tensored with every nonzero Banach space. Generic ODP/WODP tensor results found do not imply this ODP conclusion with an arbitrary second factor.

value.rationale: The result removes semifiniteness from a new noncommutative tensor ODP theorem, covers diffuse type III algebras, preserves contractive exact-target witnesses, and identifies normal-functional rectangular-corner localization as a reusable replacement for trace partitions.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
